pieces.Text: A Great Old One does not need to eat, drink, or breathe, nor does it age. A Great Old One that is slain does not truly die.
A Great Old One has mythic power (10/day, surge +1d12) and counts as a 10th-rank mythic creature. It can use any of its spell-like abilities as the mythic versions of those spells (if such exists).
A Great Old One's aura inflicts intense mental anguish and torment upon all creatures within 300 feet who can see and hear the Great Old One.
All Great Old Ones gain a +10 insight bonus on Initiative checks and to AC.
Immunity to ability damage, ability drain, aging, cold, death effects, disease, energy drain, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, and petrification.
Interacting directly with a Great Old One's thoughts (such as via detect thoughts or telepathy) forces a Will save to avoid being driven permanently insane. The save DC is
A Great Old One's natural weapons, as well as any weapon it wields, are treated as chaotic, epic, and mythic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
